description.narrative: UNPRPD Joint Programme will consolidate multi-stakeholder commitment to the achievement of CRPD-compliant SDGs through a robust legislative/policy framework, sound coordination structures and meaningful participation of OPDs.

sector.narrative: Structural transformation, including green, inclusive and digital transitions

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
UNDP as the Implementing Partner will comply with the policies, procedures and practices of the United Nations Security Management System (UNSMS.)

1.1.1. # 82 participants (offline and online) out of which 44 OPD reps and 38 reps of govt # 21 OPDs 2.1.1 # July 25, 2022 the National Social Protection Strategy approved by the gov’t. # 1 capacity building for ADMSS and ADU – two main stakeholders in SSD; 1 Guide on SSD; 1 Recommendation on SSD 3.1. In Nov 2022, the ADMSS, OPDs, MinFin, ADU, SSC introduced to disability costing and budgeting in compliance with CRPD, to data collection, analysis and use to identify gaps and improve the budget allocation and usage. ADU partnered to train OPDs on CRPD/SDG and civic monitoring. OHCHR run Youth HR School for youth with disabilities and organized December Global Forum on Human rights Education, as part of its advocacy. The national SDG has data for indicators 4.a.1. (primary and secondary education accessible information and infrastructure), 1.3.1.1 benefits coverage for disability, 1.a.2 healthcare and social protection, 1.b.1 support to low-income groups, 8.5.2. disability-related unemployment rate, 11.2.1 GP and PwD with access to public transport, 16 has no national disability indicators 3.3. The OPDs introduced to CRPD-compliant disability costing and budgeting, data collection, analysis and use to improve the budget allocation. The ADU partnered to deliver a training for other organizations on persons with disabilities on SDG and inclusive development (Nov 2022). OPD trained in shadow reporting to CRPD and introduced into HRBA-indicators and human rights approach to data in the context of UN CRPD (April and July 2022). The Youth HR School organized by OHCHR allowed to reach out to disability activists, WwD and PwDs from the provinces (May 2022).
